summary: YunoHost is a server operating system designed to simplify the administration of self-hosted services. It provides an interface to manage web applications, users, and domains without requiring deep Linux administration expertise.
goodFor: This is a suitable choice if you want to run multiple self-hosted services on a dedicated server but prefer a unified management layer rather than configuring everything manually via the command line.
watchOut: Operating systems that take over server administration can sometimes make it harder to debug low-level configuration issues or integrate with complex existing infrastructure setups.
deployNotes: Because it acts as a base server operating system built with Python and shell scripts, it typically requires a dedicated clean machine or virtual private server rather than running as a standard containerised application.
